@concat('"SELECT BAT.BATCH_ID, MAST.REPT_ID, BATDET.SCHD_ID , MAST.REPT_ARCH, OUTP.AMCTR_DESC REPT_OUTP, OUTA.AMCTR_DESC REPT_OUTA, MAST.REPT_QUERY1, MAST.REPT_QUERY2 
FROM AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT BAT
INNER JOIN MSB_REPORT_BAT_DET BATDET ON BAT.BATCH_ID = BATDET.BATCH_ID AND BATDET.BAT_DET_STS = 1 and REPT_STS = ''A'' and SCHD_STS = ''A''
INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_REPORT_MASTER MAST ON MAST.REPT_ID = BATDET.REPT_ID
INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_MCTR_LKUP OUTP ON OUTP.AMCTR_ENTITY =''REMA'' and OUTP.AMCTR_TYPE =''OUTP'' and OUTP.AMCTR_VALUE = MAST.REPT_OUTP
INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_MCTR_LKUP OUTA ON OUTA.AMCTR_ENTITY =''REMA'' and OUTA.AMCTR_TYPE =''OUTA'' and OUTA.AMCTR_VALUE = MAST.REPT_OUTA
WHERE BAT.BATCH_ID = "', string(variables('PL_BATID')), '"
Order by BATDET.SCHD_PRIORITY"')

scripts.text: Select NVL(MAX(BATCH_ID),0) as  BATCH_ID from AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT
UPDATE AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT SET BATCH_STATUS = '-1'  WHERE BATCH_ID = @PL_BATID  and BATCH_STATUS <> '9'
UPDATE AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT SET BATCH_STATUS = '11'  WHERE BATCH_ID = @PL_BATID  and BATCH_STATUS = '9' and RUN_DT = @PDT_RUNDATE
INSERT INTO AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT (BATCH_ID, BATCH_DT, RUN_DT, BATCH_STATUS) Values(@PL_BATID, @PDT_BATDATE,@PDT_RUNDATE,'1' )

INSERT INTO AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT_DET (BATCH_ID, REPT_ID, REPT_STS, REPT_ARCH, REPT_OUTP, REPT_OUTA, SCHD_ID, SCHD_TYPE, SCHD_SCHD, SCHD_EFF_DT, SCHD_TERM_DT, SCHD_STS,SCHD_PRIORITY,BAT_DET_STS, BAT_DET_COUNT )
        Select @PL_BATID,  MAST.REPT_ID, MAST.REPT_STS, MAST.REPT_ARCH, MAST.REPT_OUTP, MAST.REPT_OUTA, SCHD.SCHD_ID,SCHD.SCHD_TYPE, SCHD.SCHD_SCHD, SCHD_EFF_DT,SCHD_TERM_DT,SCHD_STS,SCHD_PRIORITY
        ,Case When AGP.PKG_MSB_REPORT.FN_MSB_GET_REPORT_STS (@PDT_RUNDATE,SCHD_EFF_DT,SCHD.SCHD_SCHD) = 'N' then '0' Else '1' end STS
        ,0
        from AGP.MSB_REPORT_MASTER MAST
        INNER JOIN AGP.MSB_REPORT_SCHEDULE SCHD ON SCHD.REPT_ID = MAST.REPT_ID
        WHERE REPT_STS = 'A' AND SCHD_STS = 'A' 
           and @PDT_RUNDATE Between SCHD_EFF_DT and SCHD_TERM_DT
UPDATE AGP.MSB_REPORT_BAT SET BATCH_STATUS = '2' WHERE BATCH_ID = @PL_BATID and BATCH_STATUS ='1'
